newsitem.title: USA: Woolworth may cut back general stores - report.
newsitem.headline: Woolworth may cut back general stores - report.

text.p: Woolworth Corp is close to announcing that it will make sharp cutbacks in the number of general merchandise stores it operates, according to CNBC television.

CNBC said Woolworth will close or transform more than 200 of its 410 general merchandise stores in the United States which generate only 13 percent of revenues and cut into the retailer's profitability.
Woolworth may sublet some of the stores that have cheap long-term leases. Others may be turned into Foot Lockers, a successul division of Woolworth, and many will be closed, CNBC said.
